image_description: A close-up view of a vintage comic book cover featuring stylized, somewhat grotesque character illustrations. The cover has a red header with bold, distorted yellow and black typography. Two main characters are visible: one in the foreground wearing pink robes with dark hair, holding an object, and another in the background with pale skin and dark hair. The art style is illustrative with heavy outlines. There are signs of wear and tear on the physical object.

The facial features of the background character are slightly smeared and lack the sharp line work seen in traditional comic inking, appearing more like a digital painting blend error.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The right edge of the comic book seems to warp slightly into the background, lacking a crisp, straight physical boundary expected of a rigid paper object.
